races.name: Country & Western Night 25th April Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: La Belle Forest
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with proven C&D form and upward trajectory faces no pace pressure in small field
runners_data.comment: Improved with each run and latest C&D win was a comfortable one; can do better
runners_data.spotlight: She has improved with each of her three starts, having a bit up her sleeve when winning over C&D four weeks ago (5f); makes her handicap debut with the potential for better.

runners_data.name: Naana's Shadow
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 171-day break with new connections but solid C&D record
runners_data.comment: Progressive for Alice Haynes prior to changing hands in November; tongue tie absent today
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up twice over C&D before winning a 5f novice at Wolverhampton in October (when trained by Alice Haynes; picked up for 20,000gns by new connections one month later); remains open to further progress but the absence of her usual tongue tie sounds a note of caution.

runners_data.name: Call Margot
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer meets Alfa Duplicate on 11lb better terms from their February clash
runners_data.comment: 11lb better off with Alfa Duplicate for 1.5l on their C&D run in February; each-way shout
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 1.5l by Alfa Duplicate over C&D in February and reopposes on 11lb better terms today; could do with settling better but she can't be discounted.

runners_data.name: Filly Foden
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs the race to develop but trainer in good form early season
runners_data.comment: Won twice over the winter, including C&D, but handicapper in charge more recently
runners_data.spotlight: In good form for her new trainer early in the year, winning a C&D novice and following up in a Lingfield handicap one week later; two lesser efforts have followed and she may need some more help from the assessor.

runners_data.name: Loleeta
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 7lb claimer reducing her burden and proven AW ability
runners_data.comment: Down the field at big prices in two handicap runs this year; arrives with a point to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 5f fillies' novice a Lingfield (AW) last summer; sent off at big prices and has finished down the field in two handicap runs this year; arrives with a point to prove.

runners_data.name: Artista
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer dropping in class after disappointing recent efforts but retains 2yo ability
runners_data.comment: Two 5f wins as a 2yo; not at her best twice last month but now drops in class
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over 5f as a 2yo, including an AW nursery off 2lb lower; she needs to better last month's two runs but this is a drop in class so it isn't out of the question.

runners_data.name: Alfa Duplicate
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good current form but faces La Belle Forest on worse terms than February
runners_data.comment: Chasing a hat-trick after wins over C&D and at Newcastle (6f); likely there's more to come
runners_data.spotlight: Improved for the drop to 5f when 1.5l too strong for Call Margot over C&D in February; defied a 7lb rise when narrowly winning a 6f handicap at Newcastle 19 days ago, form that was given a handsome boost when the runner-up won at Lingfield on Good Friday; another 4lb higher today but there could well be more in the tank and her attitude will continue to stand her in good stead.

runners_data.name: Queensmaite
runners_data.note: Prominent racer having first run for 219 days but showed ability in this grade previously
runners_data.comment: Promising debut on this card 12 months ago; no progress since but still early days
runners_data.spotlight: Third of nine in the C&D maiden on this card 12 months ago; hasn't built on it in three subsequent runs but she isn't fully exposed and a bigger effort is likely to be forthcoming at some point soon.

runners_data.name: Star Marian
runners_data.comment: Non-runner
runners_data.spotlight: Non-runner.

races.paceDynamic: La Belle Forest will take this race forward from the gates with no genuine pace pressure, allowing her to dictate terms through steady fractions. Naana's Shadow, Loleeta and Queensmaite may track her in the early stages, but none are committed pace pressers. The lack of early speed will create a tactical affair where positions matter crucially in the short straight. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can secure forward positions early, as hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground from the back in a slowly-run 5f contest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If La Belle Forest breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure
scenarios.body: She can coast through comfortable splits and kick clear when ready, making full use of her proven C&D form and recent improvement curve. The tactical advantage of dictating pace in a small field becomes decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Naana's Shadow or Loleeta press La Belle Forest early
scenarios.body: The pace quickens enough to set up a driving finish between the forward runners, where Naana's Shadow's C&D experience and fresher Loleeta can capitalize. Hold-up horses remain disadvantaged by track position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The backmarkers get their chance as Call Margot, Filly Foden or Alfa Duplicate can unleash superior finishing kicks from off the pace. The 11lb swing brings Call Margot right into contention against Alfa Duplicate.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the market principals fail to fire or meet traffic problems
scenarios.body: Queensmaite's year off or Artista's class drop creates an opening for a bigger-priced winner. The competitive handicap mark spread allows for upsets if the favorites underperform.

watchPoints.text: If La Belle Forest misses the break or gets headed early, her entire tactical advantage disappears in this pace setup
Watch for Naana's Shadow's jumping from the gates after her long layoff as fitness could be masked by the break
Chloe Lyons' 7lb claim significantly reduces Loleeta's burden and could prove decisive in a tight finish
Any hold-up horse that gets too far back early will struggle to make up ground in what promises to be a tactical affair
Monitor the early fractions as anything slower than standard will heavily favor the pace-setters over closing horses

races.name: GB Civil Engineering Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Likeadyinwasp

runners_data.spotlight: 9,000gns yearling; fourth foal; closely related to winners Cheeky Stanley (6f AW; RPR 62) and Karelen (Greek 6f); dam Italian 5.5f/6f winner; likely best watched on debut.

runners_data.name: Reigning Queen
runners_data.comment: Non-runner
runners_data.spotlight: Non-runner.

runners_data.name: Shes Got A Brother

runners_data.name: Ay Up Duck
runners_data.comment: Encouraging 2nd on debut here (7f) 12 days ago but the form may not be solid; drops to 5f
runners_data.spotlight: Encouraging debut when chasing home the red-hot favourite in a 7f maiden here 12 days ago; that race was slowly run to halfway and the form doesn't look convincing; not bred to be a 5f horse either.

runners_data.name: Dolo's Star
runners_data.comment: Nearly 8l behind Vinciamo on last month's Newcastle debut; big step forward required
runners_data.spotlight: 22-1 when last of five (Vinciamo 7.75l in front of her in third) on her Newcastle debut four weeks ago; a big step forward is required.

runners_data.name: Vinciamo
runners_data.comment: Too free on stable debut (5f, AW) last month after 11 months off; still capable of better
runners_data.spotlight: Promising debut for Marcus Tregoning one year ago; absent 11 months prior to his stable debut four weeks ago, a race where he raced too freely and weakened in the final furlong (10-11 favourite); should last longer this time and he is a leading contender.

runners_data.name: Aleppo Pepper
runners_data.comment: Second of 12 in a Dundalk maiden (5f, AW) 435 days ago; market useful on stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: Well-beaten 66-1 shot on her 2yo debut; much more encouragement when second of 12 in a 5f Dundalk maiden on sole 3yo outing; that was 435 days ago and it is hard to know quite what to expect on her first run since leaving Kieran Cotter.

runners_data.name: Skip To Victory
runners_data.comment: Good efforts over C&D on her last two starts; leading form claims
runners_data.spotlight: Prominent racer; three runs this year, all over C&D and showing her best form on the second occasion (RPR 77); no obvious reason she wouldn't make another bold bid.

races.name: Book The Bistro In Sherwood Restaurant Handicap

runners_data.name: Hiya Maite
runners_data.note: Prominent runner well-suited to 5f on AW surfaces with solid recent form including good efforts over course and distance.
runners_data.comment: On a losing run but well suited by C&D and should be in the thick of it once again
runners_data.spotlight: No win since June 2024 but several good runs, including over C&D, since then; conditions suit and no obvious reason why he wouldn't be in the thick of it again.

runners_data.name: Fidelius
runners_data.note: Strong prominent style with three recent AW wins showing excellent current form, though held by Spring Is Sprung on January course form.
runners_data.comment: Enjoyed a good winter, winning three times; held by Spring Is Sprung on C&D run in January
runners_data.spotlight: Three AW wins since November, the latest a comfortable success at Lingfileld; held by Spring Is Sprung on C&D form from January but he should give his running again.

runners_data.name: Master Of My Fate
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with three course wins to his credit but form has dipped since February course success.
runners_data.comment: Three-time C&D winner, the latest in February; not quite so good twice since
runners_data.spotlight: Game effort when winning over C&D in February (his third C&D success) but he hasn't been at quite the same level twice since; this looks a warm race for the grade and he may come up short once again.

runners_data.name: Spring Is Sprung
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who got the better of Fidelius over course and distance on return, purple patch last summer.
runners_data.comment: C&D win in January; only 4th in a stronger race last month; bold bid expected
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner; enjoyed a purple patch last summer, landing a big payday when scoring at Haydock in August; got the better of Fidelius over C&D on his return to action in January and he meets his old rival on 1lb better terms today; only fourth in a higher grade last time but he can make a bold bid back into 0-85 company.

runners_data.name: Far Above The Law
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 170-day break with new connections, handy weight but fitness question.
runners_data.comment: Of interest on best form for Alice Haynes; sold 40,000gns in October; betting to guide
runners_data.spotlight: His two wins for Alice Haynes came over 6f but he wasn't beaten far dropped to 5f when last seen in October; sold for 40,000gns soon afterwards; on a handy mark ahead of his stable debut; goes without headgear; betting should guide.

runners_data.name: Diomed Spirit
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose style may struggle in this pace scenario, best form came in weaker company.
runners_data.comment: Needs to bounce back from two lesser runs; last win came in Class 5 company
runners_data.spotlight: Successful in a Class 5 handicap at Lingfield in November off a 1lb lower mark; not at his best on his last two starts and may prove vulnerable again.

runners_data.name: Marty Hopkirk
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 232-day layoff with limited AW experience, fitness and surface concerns.
runners_data.comment: Struggled in good handicaps on final 2 runs in 2025; low mileage; down in class for return
runners_data.spotlight: AW novice winner; good second at Doncaster on his handicap debut in July (5f, good to firm) but he came up short in hot contests twice after; still has low mileage and interesting back down in class after a layoff.

races.paceDynamic: Spring Is Sprung will lead from the gates with his confirmed front-running style, setting what should be a sustainable gallop over this sharp 5f trip. The prominent racers Fidelius, Hiya Maite, Master Of My Fate and Marty Hopkirk will track closely behind, creating a compact group through the early stages. With only one natural leader and plenty of prominent runners, the pace is unlikely to be severe, allowing the race to develop into a sprint finish. This tactical setup clearly favours prominent racers who can position close to the pace and have the tactical speed to strike in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Spring Is Sprung sets an honest but not punishing gallop without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect trip tracking the leader before unleashing their finish. Fidelius and Master Of My Fate benefit most from this tactical scenario with their proven 5f speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Spring Is Sprung gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run and the prominent pack can't reel him back in time over this minimum trip. Spring Is Sprung's front-running tactics prove decisive with the field too far back at the business end.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too fast chasing Spring Is Sprung in the early stages
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more testing than expected, setting up Diomed Spirit to come from off the pace. His hold-up style allows him to pick up the pieces when the early leaders tire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Course Specialist
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to fire and racing luck plays a decisive role
scenarios.body: Master Of My Fate's three course wins become the deciding factor in a messy finish. His local knowledge and proven 5f ability at this venue carries him through when others disappoint.

watchPoints.text: Spring Is Sprung breaking smartly and getting uncontested early fractions could make him very hard to peg back
Fidelius settling kindly in the second or third position to get the perfect stalking trip behind the leader
Master Of My Fate getting outpaced early given his three course wins suggest he needs to be positioned handily
Far Above The Law showing any signs of ring-rustiness after 170 days off the track with new trainer
Diomed Spirit getting squeezed for racing room from his hold-up position in what could be a bunched finish

runners_data.name: Salamis Bay
runners_data.comment: Debut effort was promising but she may not come into her own until tackling 7f+

runners_data.spotlight: Finished in midfield at Newcastle in her one start for Ed Walker as a 2yo (RPR 56); picked up by new connections for 7,000gns last October; pedigree offers hope of much better at some point.

runners_data.name: Jumeirah Sands

runners_data.spotlight: Winless since 2023 and he signed off for last term with a below-par 14th in November Handicap at Doncaster in November; yard is going well though so no forlorn hope off a reduced mark.

runners_data.name: Carlton
runners_data.note: Prominent style ideally suited to track uncontested leader, excellent recent form including hurdles win, 5lb claimer reduces weight
runners_data.comment: Thriving and won at Chelmsford before emphatic Huntingdon hurdles victory; big shout
runners_data.spotlight: Thriving at present and he followed up 1m6f Chelmsford success in February with an emphatic victory over hurdles at Huntingdon last month; big shout once more.

runners_data.name: Imperial Sovereign
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs strong pace to be effective, good late 2025 AW form but 131 days since last run
runners_data.comment: On a lengthy losing sequence but he ended 2025 in very good form on the AW; possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: On a lengthy losing sequence but he ended 2025 in very good form on the AW, third in 1m6f Wolverhampton handicap in November; possibilities.

runners_data.name: Rock N Roll Pinkie
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse struggles with tactical scenario, three-time winner in 2025 but poor final run and 162 days absent
runners_data.comment: Enjoyed a good 2025 when a three-time winner; has gone well off a break too
runners_data.spotlight: Enjoyed a good 2025 when a three-time winner (from 1m6f to 2m) but she came in last in 1m6f Nottingham handicap on her final run in October; has gone well off a break, though.

runners_data.name: Peaky Blinder
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with Oisin Murphy booking, 187 days off but gelded since last run, longer trip should suit
runners_data.comment: Scored at Redcar in October; this longer trip promises to suit and yard is going very well
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage son of Soldier Hollow who advanced his form when landing 1m6f handicap at Redcar in October; off since (gelded) but this longer trip promises to suit and yard continues to go very well.

runners_data.name: Senor Cortez
runners_data.note: Natural front runner faces no early pressure, new yard debut but encouraging recent third, lowest weight significant advantage
runners_data.comment: Encouraging start for new yard when third at Lingfield 20 days ago; likely better to come
runners_data.spotlight: Scored twice (1m6f/2m) for Darryll Holland last summer and he made an encouraging start for his new yard when third of seven in 2m Lingfield handicap 20 days ago; remains quite lightly raced and likely better to come.

races.paceDynamic: Senor Cortez is the sole identified front runner and will face no early pressure in this small field, allowing him to dictate terms from the outset. Carlton sits prominently behind while Adjuvant, Imperial Sovereign, Rock N Roll Pinkie and Peaky Blinder all prefer to be held up, creating a tactical imbalance. With no pace pressure, Senor Cortez can control fractions and kick when it suits, while the hold-up horses risk getting caught flat-footed if he quickens. This shape strongly favours the early pace-setters who can avoid traffic problems and time their moves from advantageous positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Senor Cortez gets soft fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: He can dictate every fraction and time his kick perfectly, while the massed hold-up horses struggle to close the gap when he accelerates. The lack of early pace allows him to save energy for a sustained finish that the closers cannot match.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Carlton can track Senor Cortez into ideal striking position
scenarios.body: The prominent runner gets the perfect tactical trip behind the uncontested leader and can time his challenge to perfection. His current form edge and tactical advantage prove decisive as the hold-up horses are poorly positioned.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Flies Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong despite appearances
scenarios.body: The early leaders go too fast trying to make all, setting up a classic closer's finish. Imperial Sovereign or Peaky Blinder can unleash superior finishing kicks to collar the tiring pace-setters in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Senor Cortez goes too slow and it becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The crawling pace negates stamina advantages and turns it into a pure speed contest from the home turn. Any horse with tactical pace can win, creating an unpredictable finish where positioning trumps form.

watchPoints.text: Senor Cortez stealing an unbeatable lead if he gets uncontested fractions and the field leaves it too late to respond
Carlton getting the perfect stalking trip behind Senor Cortez while the hold-up horses struggle for clear runs
Imperial Sovereign and Peaky Blinder needing the pace to develop strongly to bring their finishing kicks into play
The entire field of hold-up horses getting caught in a tactical trap if they all wait too long to make their moves
Rock N Roll Pinkie and Adjuvant overcoming long layoffs and poor tactical positioning in this specific race shape

runners_data.name: Tilted Kilt

races.paceDynamic: Down To The Kid will make the running from his proven prominent position, with Star Studied, Silver Trumpet, Gunlock and Shimmering Spin all drawn to race handy in the early stages. This creates a potentially crowded front section with multiple prominent runners vying for position behind the leader. The pace should be genuine but not destructive given the relatively small field and Down To The Kid's ability to sustain his effort. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can secure good early positions and hold their ground through the turn.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Down To The Kid sets sustainable fractions and the prominent pack stays intact
scenarios.body: The genuine pace allows the early positioned horses to maintain their advantage with the small field unable to generate enough late pressure. Down To The Kid and the prominent runners simply prove too hard to pass from their forward berths.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too fast early or gets into a speed duel
scenarios.body: The forward runners compromise each other allowing Eldrickjones and Tilted Kilt to pick up the pieces with their superior finishing kicks. Both hold-up horses have the class to capitalise if the pace scenario unfolds in their favour.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Course Winner Returns
scenarios.trigger: If Down To The Kid reproduces his proven Southwell form and gets an easy lead
scenarios.body: The defending course winner settles into his rhythm uncontested and simply proves too good at his happy hunting ground. His excellent Southwell record and current form make him very hard to beat if allowed to dictate terms.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fresh Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Tilted Kilt or Silver Trumpet benefit significantly from their lengthy breaks
scenarios.body: The returning horses show marked improvement from their freshened state while others may have gone backwards since their recent runs. Both have shown they can perform well when fresh and their absence could be a positive.

watchPoints.text: Down To The Kid getting an uncontested lead could make him very hard to peg back on his favoured course
Tilted Kilt and Silver Trumpet both returning from lengthy breaks - fitness versus freshness factor crucial
The prominent pack of Star Studied, Silver Trumpet, Gunlock and Shimmering Spin creating early crowding behind the leader
Eldrickjones needing the early pace to develop into a strong gallop to suit his hold-up style
Gunlock making his debut for new trainer Ross Burdon after winning for previous yard in December

runners_data.name: Lady Of Clover
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner improving with each start, excellent third on handicap debut 16 days ago
runners_data.comment: Excellent third at Wolverhampton latest; can go well off unchanged mark in a refitted hood
runners_data.spotlight: Has improved with each of her three starts for her current yard, posting an excellent third of nine on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton (8.5f) 16 days ago; she can go well again off an unchanged mark in a refitted hood.

runners_data.name: Harswell River
runners_data.note: Lone front runner who will set the pace, won once but failed to progress in four subsequent runs
runners_data.comment: Opened her account at Redcar (1m) in September but failed to go on in four subsequent runs
runners_data.spotlight: Opened her account at Redcar (1m) in September but failed to go on in four subsequent runs, only sixth in 1m Newcastle nursery in December; she needs to take a big step forward.

runners_data.name: Electrocution

runners_data.comment: Good third of 11 in Chelmsford handicap four weeks ago; can make his presence felt again
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark at Wolverhampton (7f) in February and has continued in good form, third of 11 in 7f Chelmsford handicap four weeks ago; in the mix again stepped up to 1m.

runners_data.name: What Fools Believe

runners_data.spotlight: Zoustar filly who has cut little ice in her four runs to date, last of seven on her handicap debut at Newcastle (7f) 49 days ago; lots more is required.

runners_data.name: Captain Bruce

races.paceDynamic: Harswell River is the only confirmed front runner in this 14-runner field and will dictate terms from the start. With City Of Dreams and Hazy Cosmic Jane sitting prominent but no other early pace pressure, Harswell River can set a measured tempo without being hassled. The race sets up as a sit-and-sprint affair with a large pack of hold-up horses waiting to pounce in the final two furlongs. This pace scenario strongly favours the prominent and midfield runners who can track the leader without getting involved in a late scramble, as the hold-up brigade will face a traffic nightmare with 10+ horses coming from behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Harswell River faces no early pressure and sets steady fractions
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter gets an easy lead and stays on grimly as the chasing pack arrives too late. Prominent runners get first run at the leader while hold-up horses encounter traffic problems.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If City Of Dreams and Hazy Cosmic Jane track the leader perfectly
scenarios.body: The pair shadow Harswell River before quickening smoothly in the straight while the hold-up horses get shuffled back. Their prominent positions give them the clearest passage to victory.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If one of the strong finishers finds clear daylight in the straight
scenarios.body: Despite traffic concerns, a classy hold-up performer like Electrocution or Lady Of Clover weaves through to deliver a telling late surge. Class tells over position as stamina kicks in.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large field causes severe interference problems turning in
scenarios.body: Multiple horses get hampered in the straight creating a muddling finish where any horse finding room can win. The race becomes a lottery favouring whoever gets the clearest run.

watchPoints.text: Harswell River could steal this if allowed uncontested lead - no other confirmed early pace in 14-runner field
Traffic problems inevitable with 10+ hold-up horses - watch for interference in straight affecting multiple runners
City Of Dreams and Hazy Cosmic Jane must position perfectly behind leader - any mistake costs them clear runs
Electrocution stepping up from 7f to 1m for first time - stamina question at new trip needs answering
Lady Of Clover's rapid improvement curve continues - watch if she can maintain upward trajectory third start for yard
